SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(oi.product_price) AS beverage_revenue, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS beverage_items
FROM jaffle_shop.dev.order_items oi
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE oi.is_drink_item = 1
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY beverage_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10
